title: DISCRETE-TIME SIGNAL PROCESSING
description: Examines discrete-time (DT) signals and systems. Explores DT signals and linear time-invariant systems in time and frequency domains. Applies DT convolution in the time domain. Presents complex sinusoids and phasor representation for frequency analysis. Analyzes signals and systems in DT using DT Fourier series and transform.
registration_restrictions:
Prerequisites: MTH 251Z, 251HZ, 251 or 251H.
A minimum grade of C is required in MTH 251Z, MTH 251HZ, MTH 251 and MTH 251H.
